fib: ______ are known as level-sensitive because their outputs are affected by their inputs as long as they are enabled.
Latches
Latches are known as level-sensitive because their outputs are affected by their inputs as long as they are enabled.
______ are used to overcome this difficulty.
Flip-flops
Flip-flops are used to overcome this difficulty.
______ are the outputs of the B and C flip-flops, so the NAND output will go LOW whenever B = C =.
inputs to the NAND gate
The inputs to the NAND gate are the outputs of the B and C flip-flops, so the NAND output will go LOW whenever B = C = 1.
______ is called a Boolean variable if x takes on only values in B, i.e. either 0 or.
variable x
A variable x is called a Boolean variable if x takes on only values in B, i.e. either 0 or 1.
______ is the final equation, f = x' (xy' + (y ⊕ z)), at the output of the circuit.
Boolean function for the circuit
The Boolean function for the circuit is the final equation, f = x' (xy' + (y ⊕ z)), at the output of the circuit.

resulting circuit
The resulting circuit is known as a synchronous counter.
